camel_example: aliyun ndr DescribeBlockingRecords --region cn-hangzhou --PageSize 10 --BlockingType ip --EndTime 1788393600000 --NextToken '""' --MaxResults 10 --StartTime 1788307200000 --SortOrder desc --Page 1 --BlockingDirection in --SortField task_time --Lang zh --TaskStatus 2 --BlockingEntity '203.0.113.10' --TaskType 0 --BlockingProduct cfw --version 2024-01-24 --method POST --force
description_en: Performs a paging query to retrieve the task records and execution results for blocking, unblocking, policy modification, and deletion operations
description_zh: 分页查询封禁、解封及策略修改、删除的任务记录和执行结果
kebab_example: aliyun ndr describe-blocking-records --page 1 --page-size 10 --blocking-type ip --blocking-entity 203.0.113.10 --blocking-direction in --task-type 0 --task-status 2 --start-time 1788307200000 --end-time 1788393600000 --sort-field task_time --sort-order desc --max-results 10 --next-token '""' --lang zh --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeBlockingRecords

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，从 1 开始，省略时为 1
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. If the value is less than or equal to 0, it is treated as 10. If the value is greater than 100, it is treated as 100. Specify a value from 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页条数，默认 10；小于等于 0 时按 10，大于 100 时按 100。建议传入 1～100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The blocking type filter. A value of ip indicates IPv4 addresses, and a value of domain indicates domain names. If this parameter is not specified, no filter is applied
parameters.help_zh: 封禁类型筛选。ip 表示 IPv4，domain 表示域名；省略时不按类型筛选
parameters.name: blocking_type

parameters.help_en: The keyword of the blocking entity. Fuzzy match is performed on IPv4 addresses or domain names. If this parameter is not specified, no filter is applied
parameters.help_zh: 封禁实体关键词，对 IPv4 或域名做包含匹配；省略时不按实体筛选
parameters.name: blocking_entity

parameters.help_en: The direction filter. Exact match is performed based on in, out, or bidirectional. If this parameter is not specified, no filter is applied. A value of in does not match bidirectional
parameters.help_zh: 方向筛选，按 in、out 或 bidirectional 精确匹配；省略时不按方向筛选。in 不会同时匹配 bidirectional
parameters.name: blocking_direction

parameters.help_en: The task type. Valid values: 0 (manual blocking), 1 (system blocking), 2 (manual unblocking), 3 (system unblocking), 4 (configuration modification), and 5 (configuration deletion). If this parameter is not specified, no filter is applied
parameters.help_zh: 任务类型。0：手动封禁；1：系统封禁；2：手动解封；3：系统解封；4：修改配置；5：删除配置。 省略时不按该字段筛选
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en: The task execution status. Valid values: 0 (pending), 1 (running), 2 (successful), and 3 (failed). If this parameter is not specified, no filter is applied
parameters.help_zh: 任务执行状态。0：待执行；1：执行中；2：执行成功；3：执行失败。 省略时不按该字段筛选
parameters.name: task_status

parameters.help_en: The lower bound of the query time range for task creation. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. The boundary is included. If this parameter is not specified, no lower bound is applied
parameters.help_zh: 任务创建时间的查询下界，Unix 毫秒时间戳，包含边界；省略时不限制下界
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The upper bound of the query time range for task creation. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. The boundary is included. If this parameter is not specified, no upper bound is applied
parameters.help_zh: 任务创建时间的查询上界，Unix 毫秒时间戳，包含边界；省略时不限制上界
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The sort field. A value of task_time sorts results by task creation time, which is the default value. A value of blocking_count sorts results by the total number of retained task records for the same entity, regardless of the success status, current filter conditions, or hit count
parameters.help_zh: 排序字段。task_time 按任务创建时点排序（默认），blocking_count 按同一实体的全部保留任务记录数排序；不限成功状态，不受本次筛选条件限制，也不是命中数
parameters.name: sort_field

parameters.help_en: The sort order. A value of asc indicates ascending order, and a value of desc indicates descending order. Default value: desc
parameters.help_zh: 排序方向。asc 表示升序，desc 表示降序；默认降序
parameters.name: sort_order

parameters.help_en: A reserved parameter for compatibility. This parameter is not used to control the number of returned entries. Use PageSize to specify the number of entries per page
parameters.help_zh: 兼容保留参数，当前不用于控制返回数量；请使用 PageSize 设置每页条数
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: A reserved parameter for compatibility. This operation does not support cursor-based pagination. Omit this parameter and use Page and PageSize. The example uses double quotes in JSON to represent an empty string, which is not a valid cursor
parameters.help_zh: 兼容保留参数，本接口不支持游标分页；请省略此参数，使用 Page 和 PageSize。示例以 JSON 的双引号表示空字符串，不是可用游标
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The language of the response. A value of zh indicates Chinese, and a value of en indicates English. If this parameter is not specified or is left empty, Chinese is used. Other non-empty values are treated as English
parameters.help_zh: 描述语言。zh 表示中文，en 表示英文；省略或空字符串时为中文，其他非空值按英文处理
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The product filter. Valid values: cfw and waf
parameters.name: blocking_product

schema.description_en: The processing result of the request

Data.description_en: The business result returned by the operation
Data.description_zh: 本次操作返回的业务结果

List.description_en: The list of blocking task records on the current page. This list may be empty if no matching records are found
List.description_zh: 本页封禁任务记录列表，无匹配时可能为空

BlockingConfigDiff.description_en: The changes in the blocking configuration before and after the task is executed. The value is a JSON string that may contain the before and after objects. The after object is not included when the configuration is deleted. The value is empty when no snapshot is available. Snapshots may be included in blocking, unblocking, configuration modification, and configuration deletion records. In the objects, blockingDirection, blockingExpireTime, blockingStatus, and blockingReason indicate the direction, UNIX expiration timestamp in milliseconds, status, and reason, respectively
BlockingConfigDiff.description_zh: 本次任务执行前后的封禁配置变化，JSON 字符串，可包含 before 和 after 对象。删除配置时不包含 after，没有可用快照时为空。封禁、解封、修改和删除配置记录均可能包含快照。对象中的 blockingDirection、blockingExpireTime、blockingStatus、blockingReason 分别表示方向、Unix 毫秒过期时点、状态和原因
BlockingConfigDiff.title_en: 配置修改记录（JSON 字符串），仅修改/删除配置任务有值
BlockingConfigDiff.title_zh: 配置修改记录（JSON 字符串），仅修改/删除配置任务有值

BlockingDirection.description_en: A reserved field for compatibility. The task direction is not returned currently. To obtain the direction information, call DescribeBlockingTaskStatus. The example only illustrates the field format
BlockingDirection.description_zh: 兼容保留字段，当前不返回任务方向；如需方向信息，请调用 DescribeBlockingTaskStatus。示例仅说明字段格式

BlockingEntity.description_en: The IPv4 address or domain name of the blocked object
BlockingEntity.description_zh: 封禁对象的 IPv4 地址或域名
BlockingEntity.title_en: 被封禁的实体（IP 或域名）
BlockingEntity.title_zh: 被封禁的实体（IP 或域名）

BlockingExpireTime.description_en: The blocking expiration time carried in the task record, which is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. For blocking tasks, a value of 0 or null indicates that the block never expires. Other tasks may not carry this value. To query the expiration time of the current policy, call DescribeBlockingPolicies
BlockingExpireTime.description_zh: 任务记录携带的封禁过期时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳。封禁任务中 0 或空值表示永不过期，其他任务可能未携带该值；当前策略过期时间请查询 DescribeBlockingPolicies
BlockingExpireTime.title_en: 封禁过期时间戳（毫秒），null 表示永不过期
BlockingExpireTime.title_zh: 封禁过期时间戳（毫秒），null 表示永不过期

BlockingProduct.description_en:
The blocking product. Valid values:
cfw: Cloud Firewall.
waf: Web Application Firewall (WAF)
BlockingProduct.description_zh: 封禁产品，cfw表示云防火墙，waf表示Web应用防火墙

items.description_en:
The identifier of the blocking product. Valid values:
cfw: Cloud Firewall.
waf: Web Application Firewall (WAF)
items.description_zh: 封禁产品标识：cfw为云防火墙，waf为Web应用防火墙
items.title_en: 封禁产品标识：cfw为云防火墙，waf为Web应用防火墙
items.title_zh: 封禁产品标识：cfw为云防火墙，waf为Web应用防火墙

BlockingProduct.title_en: 封禁产品，cfw表示云防火墙，waf表示Web应用防火墙
BlockingProduct.title_zh: 封禁产品，cfw表示云防火墙，waf表示Web应用防火墙

BlockingReason.description_en: The blocking reason. This parameter may be empty
BlockingReason.title_en: 封禁原因摘要，可能为空
BlockingReason.title_zh: 封禁原因摘要，可能为空

BlockingTime.description_en: A reserved field for compatibility. The valid blocking execution time is not returned currently. Use TaskTime to view the task creation time. The example only illustrates the UNIX timestamp format in milliseconds
BlockingTime.description_zh: 兼容保留字段，当前不返回有效封禁执行时间；请使用 TaskTime 查看任务创建时间。示例仅说明 Unix 毫秒时间戳格式

BlockingType.description_en:
The object type. Valid values:
ip: IPv4 address.
domain: Domain name
BlockingType.description_zh: 封禁对象类型。ip 表示 IPv4 地址，domain 表示域名

Description.description_en: The description of the task failure reason. The language is determined by Lang. The value is an empty string if the task does not fail or no recognizable failure type exists. For configuration changes, see BlockingConfigDiff
Description.description_zh: 任务失败原因说明，语言由 Lang 决定。任务未失败或没有可识别的失败类型时为空字符串；配置变化请查看 BlockingConfigDiff
Description.example: 云防火墙资源配额不足，请前往云防火墙控制台扩容后重试。

FailureType.description_en:
The task failure type. This parameter can be empty. Valid values:
quota_exceeded: The resource quota of Cloud Firewall is insufficient.
data_corrupted: The associated policy or address book is abnormal.
execution_failed: The execution fails
FailureType.description_zh: 任务失败类型，可为空。quota_exceeded 表示云防火墙资源配额不足，data_corrupted 表示关联策略或地址簿异常，execution_failed 表示执行失败
FailureType.title_en: 任务失败类型，仅任务失败时有值，可能为 null
FailureType.title_zh: 任务失败类型，仅任务失败时有值，可能为 null

IncidentId.description_en: The ID of the associated security event. This parameter may be empty if no security event is associated
IncidentId.description_zh: 关联安全事件 ID，未关联时可能为空
IncidentId.title_en: 关联的安全事件 UUID，可能为 null
IncidentId.title_zh: 关联的安全事件 UUID，可能为 null

Operator.description_en: The UID of the human operator. The value is system for automated tasks, or an em dash (—) for unknown historical records
Operator.description_zh: 人工实际操作者UID；自动任务为系统；历史未知为—
Operator.title_en: 人工实际操作者UID；自动任务为系统；历史未知为—
Operator.title_zh: 人工实际操作者UID；自动任务为系统；历史未知为—

TaskId.description_en: The numeric identifier of the blocking task in the system, which is used to locate operation records
TaskId.description_zh: 封禁任务在系统中的数字标识，用于定位操作记录
TaskId.title_en: 封禁任务在系统中的数字标识，用于定位操作记录
TaskId.title_zh: 封禁任务在系统中的数字标识，用于定位操作记录

TaskStatus.description_en:
The task execution status. Valid values:
0: Pending.
1: Running.
2: Successful.
3: Failed
TaskStatus.description_zh: 任务执行状态。0：待执行；1：执行中；2：执行成功；3：执行失败
TaskStatus.title_en: 0待执行、1执行中、2成功、3失败、4部分成功
TaskStatus.title_zh: 0待执行、1执行中、2成功、3失败、4部分成功

TaskTime.description_en: The task creation time, which is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. This is not the task completion time
TaskTime.description_zh: 任务创建时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳；不是任务执行完成时间

TaskType.description_en:
The task type. Valid values:
0: Manual blocking.
1: System blocking.
2: Manual unblocking.
3: System unblocking.
4: Configuration modification.
5: Configuration deletion
TaskType.description_zh: 任务类型。0：手动封禁；1：系统封禁；2：手动解封；3：系统解封；4：修改配置；5：删除配置
TaskType.title_en: 0手动封禁、1系统封禁、2手动解封、3系统解封、4修改、5删除、6批量封禁、7应急暂停、8应急恢复
TaskType.title_zh: 0手动封禁、1系统封禁、2手动解封、3系统解封、4修改、5删除、6批量封禁、7应急暂停、8应急恢复

TaskUuid.description_en: The unique identifier of the blocking task, which is used to query the execution status and operation details
TaskUuid.description_zh: 封禁任务唯一标识，用于查询执行状态和操作详情
TaskUuid.title_en: 封禁任务唯一标识，用于查询执行状态和操作详情
TaskUuid.title_zh: 封禁任务唯一标识，用于查询执行状态和操作详情

Page.description_en: The page number used for the current query. Pages start from 1
Page.description_zh: 本次查询采用的页码，从 1 开始

PageSize.description_en: The page size used for the current query. This is not equal to the actual number of records returned on the current page
PageSize.description_zh: 本次采用的分页大小，不等于本页实际返回条数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of task records that match the filter conditions. This is not the number of records returned on the current page
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合筛选条件的任务记录总数，不是本页返回条数

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the request fails. The value is an empty string if the request is successful. The example InvalidParam indicates that the request parameter is invalid and does not represent the error code of a successful response
ErrorCode.description_zh: 请求失败时的错误码；成功时为空字符串。示例 InvalidParam 表示请求参数无效，不代表成功响应的错误码

MaxResults.description_en: A reserved field for compatibility. A valid page size is not provided currently. Use Data.PageSize instead. The example only illustrates the field format
MaxResults.description_zh: 兼容保留字段，当前不提供有效分页大小；请以 Data.PageSize 为准。示例仅说明字段格式
MaxResults.title_en: 单次请求期望返回的最大记录数
MaxResults.title_zh: 单次请求期望返回的最大记录数

Message.description_en: The result description of the request. The value is success if the request is successful, or an error message if the request fails
Message.description_zh: 本次请求的结果说明；成功时为 success，失败时返回错误说明

NextToken.description_en: A reserved field for compatibility. This API operation does not provide a cursor for the next page. Paginate based on Data.TotalCount, Data.Page, and Data.PageSize. The example uses double quotes in JSON to represent an empty string, which is not a valid cursor
NextToken.description_zh: 兼容保留字段，本接口不提供下一页游标；请依据 Data.TotalCount、Data.Page 和 Data.PageSize 翻页。示例以 JSON 的双引号表示空字符串，不是可用游标
NextToken.title_en: 分页查询使用的后续页标记
NextToken.title_zh: 分页查询使用的后续页标记

RequestId.description_en: The request ID used to troubleshoot and locate the request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于排查和定位本次请求

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the API call is successful. A value of true indicates that the request is processed successfully. A value of false indicates that the request fails. For asynchronous API operations, a value of true does not indicate that the task is completed
Success.description_zh: 本次接口调用是否成功。true 表示请求处理成功，false 表示失败；异步接口的成功不表示任务已经执行完成
